summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long NXPI Daily ETF (NXPG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of NXP Semiconductors N.V. (Nasdaq: NXPI) stock, less fees and expenses NXPG was launched on Jun 2, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
